subject: compiling amber 22 with gcc 11 / cuda 11.6: cuda error with mdgx

messages.author: Vlad Cojocaru
messages.body:
Dear Ambers,
I am trying to compile Amber 22 using gcc 11.2.0 , cuda 11.6 on a remote
HPC machine but I am getting the error below. Does anyone have an advice
on how to fix this ?
Thanks a lot
Vlad
